{{Top|canon=Galven-pattern}}
A '''galven pattern''' governed the power and damage inflicted by a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt. A galven pattern was formed in the barrel of a blaster by micro-electronics creating a [[static-pulse field]].
